title: P0.26: External Consultation Intent + User Browser Session Continuity
description: Live interaction showed two routing gaps: typo-heavy requests such as 'has una consuta a chat gpt' fell back to local chat, and user-visible ChatGPT evidence ('yo veo bien la ventana con chatgpt') did not trigger the user-browser handoff.
reason: The universal loop had the evidence, but the intent parser and security follow-up patterns were too literal. A metacognitive CDP preference was also stored only as IABV_PREFER_CDP_SESSION and was not translated into safe goal overrides for the consultation route.
next_action: Run IABV on Windows, ask 'has una consuta a chat gpt', then after any security block say 'yo veo bien la ventana con chatgpt'. Verify the first message starts external_consultation and the second enters user_browser_manual_handoff instead of visible_isolated_profile.
resume_hint: P0.26 code fix applied: typo-aware ChatGPT consultation intent, explicit assistant routing before local shortcuts, expanded user-visible ChatGPT profile mismatch detection, and IABV_PREFER_CDP_SESSION mapped to manual user-browser handoff without bypassing observation permission.

metadata.root_cause: Intent parsing recognized 'consulta' but not the live typo 'consuta', and profile mismatch detection recognized 'mi Chrome' but not the user's natural claim 'yo veo bien la ventana con chatgpt'.

tests.tool_teach_regression_note: 2 pre-existing environment-sensitive failures remain in test_tool_teach_service because the live Codex process makes codex_installed available through multi-source detection.
